# Morse — The signal studio

A browser-based, privacy-first Morse translator and personal cipher studio.

## Main pages
- / — Overview
- /encoder — Text to Morse with audio, light, vibration and tap-key input
- /decoder — Morse to text
- /alphabet — International Morse reference and app-specific Arabic/Urdu extensions
- /cipher — Emoji codebook (obfuscation) and legacy passphrase AES-256-GCM encryption
- /practice — Morse recognition quiz
- /contacts — ECDH P-256 public-key exchange, PIN-encrypted local contacts and safety fingerprints
- /privacy — Privacy practices and limitations
- /how-it-works — Browser APIs and local processing explanation
- /about — About Morse Studio
- /embed/ — Standalone embeddable Morse widget

## Privacy and security
- Morse translation and supported cryptographic operations run locally in the browser.
- No account, content analytics or message backend is required.
- Codebook mode is obfuscation, not encryption.
- Legacy Secure mode uses AES-256-GCM and PBKDF2-SHA256 with 600,000 iterations.
- ECDH contact mode uses P-256, HKDF-SHA256 and AES-256-GCM.
- Contact private keys are stored inside a PIN-encrypted local vault using PBKDF2-SHA256 (310,000 iterations).
- Safety fingerprints must be compared out of band to reduce public-key substitution risk.
- Stealth Lab supports AES-GCM encrypted messages, emoji and word-list disguise, zero-width cover text and PNG least-significant-bit steganography.
- QR generation is bundled locally; contact QR image scanning uses BarcodeDetector where supported.\n- Camera/torch, microphone decoding and animated WebM light signals depend on browser/device support.\n- The Koch learning path stores levels, streaks and milestone achievements locally.\n- A Manifest V3 Chrome extension, iframe widget and dependency-free Morse core package are included in the repository.
- Opt-in analytics stores only local per-route pageview counts; it sends no analytics requests.
- Expiry is checked during decryption. View-once clearing is best-effort, not screenshot-proof.

## Limitations
- No protection against compromised devices, malicious browser extensions, screenshots, weak PINs, traffic analysis or recipient copies.
- Fixed-size padding reveals a size bucket, not the exact original message length.
- Arabic/Urdu mappings are app-specific extensions and are not represented as a universal official Morse standard.
- Browser audio, vibration, clipboard and sharing depend on device support.\n- Argon2id WASM and full-page English/Urdu/Arabic/Hindi localization are not included. The bundled six-word phrase generator is Diceware-style, not the official 7776-word Diceware list.
- Legacy passphrase ciphertext and ECDH contact envelopes are different formats.
